61fff20f888fc004: A Swift class can inherit from another class, clarifying relationships and enabling fine-grained code sharing. Non-reference types, such as structures and enumerations, cannot inherit from classes. A value type can conform to a protocol, and protocols can inherit from protocols. Protocols contain type information rather than implementation code, but protocol extensions can contain code. This enables a code-sharing inheritance tree with value types at the leaves and protocols and their extensions at the roots and internal nodes.
